capability_rows.capability: check how an installed app is hardened, from its files and the system's code signature, without launching it
switch an installed site's serving on or off, with or without receiving email, keeping its existing files

authorship_evidence.scope: This reuses the existing main-line contract for the narrow compatibility seam only. The historical algorithm remains owned by the separate SOURCE_FIRST_PORT core contract; no algorithm is claimed as newly authored.

source_live_status.status: The old source path is retired on committed main according to the historical contract; immutable history and evidence remain. The PR receives the implementation only after a new exact active-core baseline.
